_comment: Row 284. The behavioral catcher reaches one matching receipt and one reap through the real settlement path, consumes each transport's supplied allowance with a synchronized wait, and measures wall elapsed. M1 restores the independent sixty-second reap; M2 makes reap discard the caller's remaining budget; M3 restores the one-second probe floor. The separate transform-control spec applies M1 while running only the module import control and must ESCAPE.
subject: row 284 -- every ambiguous-launch subprocess stays inside the settlement deadline governing the item

mutants.label: M1 ambiguous settlement starts an independent sixty-second reap again
mutants.old:
verdict = reap(
                addr, receipt_path, "ambiguous launch result",
                timeout=min(60.0, reap_budget))

mutants.label: M2 reap discards the remaining settlement allowance
M3 a nearly spent settlement rounds its probe allowance up to one second
mutants.new: probed = ssh(addr, command, timeout=max(1, min(5, math.ceil(remaining))))
